mathematical_definition: Among the trailing 60 fully-resolved historical start points t0 whose forward sub_horizon=10-bar path reached the 0.001 (10bps) threshold (see hist_p_reach_10bps_10b_60), hist_time_to_10bps_60 is the average number of bars taken to first reach it (total_time/n_timed) -- a LOCAL empirical first-passage TIME, distinct from the probability and frequency features in this family (numba kernel first_passage_stats, window=60, sub_horizon=10, r_threshold_frac=0.001)
numerical_stability_notes: When none of the 60 historical windows registered a hit (n_timed==0), this returns sub_horizon (10.0) as a deliberate fallback ('never reached, so treat time-to-reach as the full horizon') rather than NaN -- a real value, not a missing-data marker. Causality verified by direct code read during Phase 3 design (spec section 2): first_passage_stats's inner loop bound is t0 in [i-window-sub_horizon, i-sub_horizon) and j in (t0, t0+sub_horizon], so the maximum index ever read is j=i-1 -- every inner-loop index is strictly < i, no lookahead.
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first window+sub_horizon=70 bars; 10.0 (sub_horizon) fallback thereafter whenever no historical window hit the threshold, never zero-filled
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.217 (<0.3), MI rank 70 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.2170, cv_importance=0.4024, mi_rank=70, family=J_first_passage, family_ablation_delta=-0.000177 (<0.1pp).
